root.title: Canonical daemon planning cutover
root.objective: Cut productive daemon planning over to the canonical PlanningEngine, deterministic verifier and direct SemanticPlan-to-GraphRevision compiler while preserving lifecycle ownership and making the legacy route unreachable.

outcomes.statement: Integrate one daemon-owned productive route through canonical planning, deterministic verification and direct compilation.
Integrate explicit retirement of RecursivePlanner, WorkBreakdown projection and the legacy graph compiler from productive entrypoints.
Submit the exact integrated candidate to the registered prior-gates regression procedure.

cut.criterion: Split at application, planning, verification, compiler, legacy-retirement and regression-proof ownership boundaries.
cut.rationale: The supplied evidence identifies six exact writable resources with distinct responsibilities, while root integration owns proof of the complete productive route.

children.title: Compose canonical planning in the daemon
children.objective: Replace the daemon's recursive and projected productive route with explicit canonical planner, verifier and compiler composition while retaining lifecycle and RepositoryView ownership.

outcomes.statement: The daemon adapter is prepared to compose the only productive canonical planning route.

children.title: Establish the canonical PlanningEngine route
children.objective: Make the planning module produce the sole canonical SemanticPlan through bounded generation, canonicalization and typed outcomes.

outcomes.statement: The PlanningEngine provides the canonical SemanticPlan input for verification and compilation.

children.title: Add deterministic SemanticPlan verification
children.objective: Verify canonical SemanticPlan material and its repository, ownership, artifact, seam and validation references before direct compilation.

outcomes.statement: SemanticPlan material is deterministically checked before productive compilation.

children.title: Compile SemanticPlan directly to GraphRevision
children.objective: Accept verified SemanticPlan input and emit canonical GraphRevision output without a WorkBreakdown projection or legacy graph representation.

outcomes.statement: The productive compiler boundary directly transforms SemanticPlan into GraphRevision.

children.title: Make legacy planning unreachable
children.objective: Retire transitional productive access to RecursivePlanner, WorkBreakdown projection and the legacy graph compiler while preserving daemon-owned lifecycle recording.

outcomes.statement: The named legacy planning mechanisms are excluded from productive planning reachability.

children.title: Preserve canonical graph regression gates
children.objective: Align canonical GraphRevision validation with the direct compiler candidate so prior gates can check lifecycle ownership, exact repository grounding and graph invariants.

outcomes.statement: The exact cutover candidate is covered by the registered regression-gate procedure without weakening canonical graph checks.

seams.purpose: Carry daemon-owned productive planning input and exact repository grounding into the canonical PlanningEngine.

interface.promise: The daemon supplies the exact goal, criteria, constraints, repository snapshot and RepositoryView; the planner returns typed canonical planning outcomes.

seams.purpose: Pass the sole canonical SemanticPlan material into deterministic verification.

interface.promise: SemanticPlan retains exact GoalContract, repository snapshot and RepositoryView identities for deterministic checks.

seams.purpose: Define SemanticPlan as the direct planning input associated with GraphRevision compilation.

interface.promise: The compiler receives canonical SemanticPlan semantics without an intervening WorkBreakdown projection.

seams.purpose: Permit direct compilation only for SemanticPlan material accepted by deterministic verification.

interface.promise: Compiler input identity matches the verified SemanticPlan identity, and verifier rejection produces no graph candidate.
